QuestInfo.name: [Korean Folk Town] Wiz's Gratitude
QuestInfo.summary: You retrieved the last remaining stone and saved the Korean Folk Town from danger. Tell Wiz what happened.
QuestInfo.0: Deliver all the stones to Wiz.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver all the stones to Wiz.
QuestInfo.2:
You delivered all the gemstones to Wiz.
He was very grateful.
Moni decided to write a storybook for goblins.
The Korean Folk Town will continue to be a haven for those who want to return to the innocence of childhood.
